scientific_integrity: The theorem concerns exact regular-simplex centers and arbitrary positive unequal ball weights, not general ball placements. Equality and the strict open-ball endpoint are proved analytically; finite tests corroborate only sampled cases. Classical equal-weight width directions are credited, not treated as new.
scientific_limitations: The minimum over sign partitions can require exponential work; no optimal full nonconvexity-point set or polynomial algorithm is asserted. Earlier general weighted hyperplane-obstacle literature could contain equivalent results. No independent audit has been performed.
title: Exact weighted hyperplane-blocking thresholds for regular-simplex ball obstacles
